openRequirements.requirement: Disputed package quantities and ambiguous OCR must not produce unit-price rankings
openRequirements.finding: Disputed grams/ml remain withheld in derived views. Exact original-pixel crop transforms recover 4.5 and 4.0 from the saved manufacturer label, preserving original image/TSV, crop/renderer parameters and derived-image/TSV hashes. Identical transforms replay cached results. Crop results remain review-only; no marketplace nutrition is approved without exact flavour/market/package/formula identity.

openRequirements.requirement: Count confirmed food gifts separately from paid multipacks and accessory gifts in exact bulk orders
openRequirements.finding: Issue14 real gift remains unverified. Incomplete gifts stay potential. Confirmed gifts require stored original bytes/identity/quantity evidence, physical-unit-bound excerpts and factory review; binary labels require replayable original/crop/OCR or actual source-bound visual review. Exact SKU/order quantities count once; one allocation cannot recur on multiple basket lines. The advertised two-bag real offer also has a disputed per-pouch mass; the shared original-backed hold removes its4000g/447.50VND/g calculation without replacing it with a guess.
